## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      10 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 17 сент. 2026 г. - 27 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Gayle Warren_, 27 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "I thought I had cancelled this correctly via email. But I see you took a payment from my Visa without consent. $89.99 please ensure my account/subscription is CANCELLED I don't require it!"
            2. _Riina_, 27 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "SCAM! FORCED SUBSCRIPTION IMPOSSIBLE TO CANCEL!"
            3. _Uyen Vo_, 25 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "The app automatically charge my credit card eventhough I cancelled subscription already."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      6 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 23 мая 2026 г. - 23 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Engin Volkan_, 23 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "30 day money back guarantee has conditions which is only visible in the details of their policy. Do not assume that you can easily change your mind in 30 days. Once they have your money, they'll hold on to that as much as possible like they'll ask for screenshots and proof of usage for 7 days. How exactly is this a guarantee? Check their policy and don't be fooled with their ads. Buggy onboarding, survey keeps crashing, support manually changed it two times, but I still need proof, right..."
            2. _Sabina Kotiranta_, 23 мая 2026 г., 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
            3. _Bartholomew Lunt_, 23 июл. 2026 г., 2/5: "daily work out is good but it keeps crashing and I can't track anything except the daily workout once it actually loads."
<!--/ir-theme-->
